source.quote: Consider Procedure~\ref{alg:DAB} combining a stationary bandit algorithm $\mcal{B}$ with $R_{\mathcal{B}} = \mathcal{O}(\sqrt{A T\log(T)})$, and with a change detector $\mcal{D}$ that satisfies Property~\ref{proper:cd}, ... Suppose $\delta_{F}=\delta_{D}=T^{-\gamma}$ for some $\gamma>1$, and $\alpha_{k} = \alpha_{0}\sqrt{k A \log(T)/T}$. Then, if condition \eqref{eq:cond1} holds, $R_T \lesssim  \sqrt{A N_{T} T \log(T)}$.

results.notes: Does not require knowledge of N_T. Applies e.g. to UCB/klUCB with GLR/GSR detectors.
